# Synthesia Pricing in 2026: Is It Worth Paying For?

Synthesia sells several plans, and the right one depends on how much you use it. Below is the current lineup, what you get at each tier, and who should (or shouldn't) upgrade. *Prices are approximate and change often — confirm on the official site before buying.*

## Synthesia Plans at a Glance

| Plan | Price | What You Get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | $22/mo | 120 mins/yr |
| Creator | $67/mo | 360 mins/yr |
| Enterprise | Custom | SSO, API |

## Which Plan Should You Pick?

- **Free / trial:** best for testing the waters. L&D, corporate training can try it without risk.

- **Mid tier ($67/mo):** the sweet spot for most individuals who use Synthesia regularly.

- **Top tier (Custom):** for power users and teams that need the extra limits or seats.


## Is Synthesia Worth Paying For?

If the AI avatar video generator is central to your work — L&D, corporate training — the paid plan pays for itself quickly. If you only need occasional help, the free tier or a cheaper alternative may be enough.

**See the current offer:** {{AFFILIATE_SYNTHESIA}}

## Cheaper Alternatives

If the price is the blocker, these alternatives cost less or include a free plan:

- [[link:/tools/201|Pictory]] — the text-to-video tool
- [[link:/tools/51|VEED.io]] — the browser video editor
- [[link:/tools/79|Descript]] — the transcript-based editor

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does Synthesia cost?

Synthesia starts at $22/mo and goes up to Custom on the top tier. Exact pricing changes, so check the official site.

### Does Synthesia have a free plan?

It offers a free trial — you can test it before paying.

### Is Synthesia worth the money?

For its core audience (L&D, corporate training), yes. Lighter users may be fine on a free or cheaper alternative.
